manga.c1.title: Chapter 1 — The First Step
manga.c1.p1: Every hundred years, the Tower wakes... and the world begins to wither.
manga.c1.p2a: Whoever reaches the Summit may ask the Tower for anything.
manga.c1.p2b: Then why has nobody done it?
manga.c1.p3: Thousands climbed. Only their armor ever came back down... empty.
manga.c1.p5a: They're still up there. All of them. Still... climbing.
manga.c1.p6: She lived just long enough to give birth on the first step, and to leave her pendant with the baby.
manga.c1.p6a: Don't climb for the wish, little one... Climb to bring them home.
manga.c1.p7a: Born on the stairs... a Stairborn.
manga.c1.p8b: Then I'll be the first one it can't swallow!
manga.c1.p9: Gilt, the Treasure Imp. When he shows up, CLICK him!
manga.c1.p9a: Heh heh... a fresh climber with shiny pockets. Catch me if you can!
manga.c1.p10: Your climb begins. Every 10 floors a bonfire heals you and saves your way back.
manga.c2.title: Chapter 2 — Embers
manga.c2.p2: Fall, and the Tower spits you back down to the last bonfire. Part of your gold stays on the stairs.
manga.c2.p4b: Every bonfire is the last warmth of a fallen climber. I am one of them.
manga.c2.p5: Recruit heroes with MINT, in the Heroes panel.
manga.c2.p5a: Their echoes sleep in the ash. Offer gold, and one will rise to climb beside you.
manga.c2.p6: Equip gear by hand. Merge weak pieces into better ones.
manga.c2.p6a: And the armor that falls... wear it. They'd want it to climb again.
manga.c3.title: Chapter 3 — What the Tower Remembers
manga.c3.p2a: ...is the sun... still shining... down there?
manga.c3.p3: The monsters were climbers once. The ones who stopped climbing.
manga.c3.p4a: Their souls are free now. Carry them back to the first step... and climb again.
manga.c3.p5: ASCENSION: the Tower forgets your steps, never your soul. Souls buy power that stays forever.
manga.c4.title: Chapter 4 — Torment
manga.c4.p1: Climb high enough, and the Tower stops pretending.
manga.c4.p2: Lords carry Sigils. Arm one, defeat a guardian, open its sealed chest. Lose, and you keep the Sigil.
manga.c4.p3a: Heh! Even the Lords hide their treasure from me... not well enough!
manga.c4.p4a: Mother... I'm bringing them home. All of them.
menu.manga: Manga: the story of the Stairborn (new chapters unlock as you climb)
manga.c3.p6: Inside the colossus: only old armor... and a pendant. The same as the one {hero} has worn since the cradle.
manga.c3.p6a: We left her in the storm... forgive us... Aria...
manga.c3.p7a: Aria... So that was her name.
manga.c5.title: Chapter 5 — The Name in the Stone
manga.c5.p1: Floor 100. A wall carved with the name of every climber the Tower ever swallowed.
manga.c5.p2a: Aria... and her whole party. All of them here.
manga.c5.p3: And below them, a name still being carved...
manga.c5.p4a: Every hundred years I need a climber who never stops. Whoever reaches me... BECOMES me.
manga.c5.p5: The Tower was a climber once. The first one who ever made a wish.
manga.c5.p6a: Then I'll reach you... and say NO!
